title: CaliBench: Are the Stochastic Dynamics of Video World Models Physically Calibrated?

extra.description: Video world models approximate the stochastic distribution of physical outcomes through generative sampling, but existing benchmarks score individual generations or compare distributions coarsely over a whole dataset, leaving the fine-grained aleatoric uncertainty of specific phenomena untested.
